title: Sorting a List of Lists According to Length of Sublists

entrypoints.name: length_sort
entrypoints.description: Returns a permutation of the input outer list with nondecreasing lengths of inner lists.

entrypoints.name: frequency_sort
entrypoints.description: Returns a permutation of the input outer list with nondecreasing input-frequency of each inner-list length.

interface_notes: The official statement shows calls over string list list; the signature is necessarily element-polymorphic because neither operation needs element comparison or inspection.
No exception, option, seed, comparator, mutable state, or effect is part of the specified interface.
No tie-breaking order is stated for equal sort keys; callers may not rely on stability.
